MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19

2. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

3. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31
   D. 31.7

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 66
   C. 34
   D. 22

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 42
   C. 30
   D. 21

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. 1/4

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

8. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

9. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 16

10. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 1

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
